# atlassian_jira_permission_scheme (Resource)

Manage a Jira permission scheme. Create, update name/description, or delete. Deleting is only safe when no project uses the scheme.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "atlassian_jira_permission_scheme" "example" {
  name        = "Terraform Managed Scheme"
  description = "Permission scheme created and managed by Terraform"
}

output "permission_scheme_id" {
  value = atlassian_jira_permission_scheme.example.id
}

output "permission_scheme_name" {
  value = atlassian_jira_permission_scheme.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the permission scheme.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the permission scheme.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Permission scheme ID (set after create).
